name: RankSEO reports and keyword report detail
description: Verify the authenticated All Reports experience for a newly created test account, including empty saved-report state, report-type filters, protected report-detail routing, and responsive layout. Do not depend on pre-seeded credentials, report IDs, or mocked APIs.

planSteps.description: Start with a clean signed-out browser session and navigate to /auth/sign-up.
Verify the sign-up page shows the Name, Email, and Password fields and a Create account action.
Create a new account using a unique email address, a valid name, and the password "RankSEO-Test-2026!".
Verify account creation succeeds and authenticated dashboard navigation becomes available.
Verify the authenticated dashboard navigation exposes an All Reports destination.
Navigate to the All Reports destination.
Verify the page displays the heading "All reports", its saved-report description, and the tabs "All reports", "Keyword research", and "AI visibility".
Verify the report table area displays the expected report columns when the All reports tab is selected.
Verify the empty All reports view displays "No reports in this view yet." and does not display fabricated report rows.
Verify the empty Keyword research view displays "No reports in this view yet." and does not display report rows.
Verify the empty AI visibility view displays "No reports in this view yet." and does not display report rows.
Resize the browser viewport to approximately 390 pixels wide while remaining on the report-not-found page.
Verify the page displays "Report not found", does not expose saved report content, and remains readable without horizontal page overflow at the mobile width.
